input: Find a local figure drawing class to attend monthly

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Monthly Figure Drawing Class
gold.taskDescription: Locate and commit to attending a local figure drawing class on a monthly basis.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area to search for figure drawing classes.

questions.title: What is your current skill level in figure drawing?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced artist to find an appropriate class level.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the class?
questions.description: Establish a maximum travel distance or commute time the user is comfortable with.

questions.title: Do you prefer a studio, art school, or community center setting?
questions.description: Clarify the type of venue or organization the user would feel most comfortable attending.

questions.title: What is your budget per session or per month?
questions.description: Understand the user's financial constraints to filter class options accordingly.

questions.title: Are there specific days or times that work best for you?
questions.description: Identify scheduling preferences to match available class times.

questions.title: Do you need the class to supply drawing materials?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has their own supplies or requires a class that provides them.
